success_patterns: Refinement turns on a cached hotel domain were answered with exactly three straight-line statements: load the most refined cache key, filter with only the new constraints from the last turn (num_rooms + budget; budget + pool_present; neighborhood), then save under a new unique key. This is already covered by Rules 2, 13, 17 and 23.

When the dates for a hotel finally arrived and only restaurants were cached, the agent searched hotels alone and carried over num_rooms and num_people. It did not touch the restaurant cache. This is covered by Rule 14.

Requests with no mandatory date or city (a flight with a 'normal airport' habit, a round trip plus hotel for a 'family vacation', a restaurant with an allergy but no city) produced a single short seek_information naming only the missing mandatory items. This is covered by Rules 6, 7 and 24.
Hotel amenities and budgets mapped to single exact parameters (pool_present, budget, num_rooms, neighborhood=['Midtown Atlanta']) without extras. This is covered by Rules 10 and 22.

patch.reasoning: Every success pattern in this batch is already encoded in the skill (Rules 2, 6, 7, 10, 13, 14, 17, 22, 23, 24). The skill is already long, and recent large additions were rejected, so adding more text would risk diluting the existing rules. The one batch item that looks like a gap (trajectory 2, which loaded an uncached 'hotels' key and still scored on cache_em) was actually a code failure, not a pattern worth reinforcing. No edits are proposed.
